name: vibeward
description: Stops the insecure prompt before your AI agent runs it — and audits what it already shipped. A deterministic guardrail (no LLM call) for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Windsurf and opencode that catches "disable RLS" or "use the service_role key in the frontend" in English, Spanish and Portuguese, plus a read-only scanner for exposed secrets, open Supabase RLS and Firebase leaks in Lovable / Bolt / v0 apps. It reports; it never edits your code.

scripts.test: tsx test/self-test.ts && tsx test/prompt-test.ts && tsx test/intent-test.ts && tsx test/injection-test.ts && tsx test/hosts-test.ts && tsx test/contract-test.ts
